properties.text: You have spent your youth within Candlekeep, a walled library above the Sea of Swords. Gorion is preparing to leave, and urges you to buy what you need. Before meeting him at the library steps, you may help old friends, explore the grounds, train with the Watch, or learn what the walls have hidden. This scenario ends when you choose to leave with Gorion. Native hero statistics determine social, theft and lock outcomes.

properties.description: Return Firebead's identify scroll.
properties.objective: Find Tethtoril in the grounds and return his scroll to Firebead.
properties.rewardText: 50 experience, a healing potion, and Protection from Evil.
properties.hint: Tethtoril walks near the central library.

properties.description: Recover Phlydia's History of Halruaa.
properties.objective: Search Dreppin's hay for Phlydia's lost book.
properties.rewardText: 50 experience; a lynx-eye gem unless your social reaction is unfavorable.
properties.hint: Dreppin saw the book near the hay.
properties.completedText: Recover Phlydia's History of Halruaa — completed.

properties.description: Bring an antidote for Dreppin's cow.
properties.objective: Fetch the antidote from Hull's barracks chest for Nessa.
properties.hint: Hull keeps an antidote beside his sword.
properties.completedText: Bring an antidote for Dreppin's cow — completed.

properties.description: Return Hull's forgotten sword.
properties.objective: Retrieve Hull's sword from his barracks chest.
properties.rewardText: 50 experience and 10 gold; 20 gold with a high social reaction.
properties.hint: The barracks stand on the southwestern wall.

properties.description: Bring Fuller twenty crossbow bolts.
properties.objective: Buy a bundle of twenty bolts from Winthrop and take it to Fuller.
properties.rewardText: 50 experience and 10 gold, or the shared Dagger +1 with a high social reaction.
properties.hint: Winthrop sells a bundle for one gold.
properties.completedText: Bring Fuller twenty crossbow bolts — completed.

properties.description: Clear five rats from Reevor's storehouse.
properties.objective: Defeat the five rats inside the eastern storehouse.
properties.rewardText: 50 experience and 5 gold, plus one experience per rat.
properties.completedText: Clear five rats from Reevor's storehouse — completed.
